Otherwise dispatches through DoubleCallWrapper(a1, a2), which resolves a two-argument callable and returns a result pointer v4
When v4 is non-null, calls SingleFunctionCallWrapper_7f59(v4[1]) and returns its int result
When the dispatch wrapper returns null, falls back to returning the default value a3
